description: Phase 3B. Exercises hedged-at-4s fallback behaviour: the soak knob `soak_burn_rendezvous_channel` marks the priority[0] channel (`domain_fronted_broker`) as burned for 5 consecutive attempts on day 7. The Selector MUST observe priority[0] failing within hedge_interval, fire the rest of the priority list in parallel, and a lower-priority channel (`sqs`) MUST win and be recorded as the per-route + per-network last_winning_rendezvous_channel. Burn pressure is then released on day 9 and the engine MUST resume preferring the netmem-hinted winner from day 7. The legacy subscription-url block holds throughout so the distribution-failure invariants are preserved.
